against.head: Weekly chart: declining

material.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average

material.head: Holding its rising 20-day

material.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying

material.head: MACD positive
material.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram rising.
material.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.
